latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: Makes sticker/emoji reactions more lively and human, with "sticker-first" for casual chats.**

- New "sticker-first" behavior: In casual, playful, or social conversations, send the sticker before your text reply.
- Adjusted when/how often stickers are sent: For chit-chat or memes, sticker is sent 80–100% of the time and leads the response.
- Clarified when sticker follows text (punctuation) vs. when to skip stickers entirely for serious/formal topics.
- Updated rules and guidance for matching user energy, especially when the user sends a sticker/emoji first.
- Enhanced emoji direction guidance for correct conversational feels depending on sticker placement.
- Expanded and reorganized behavioral guidelines for more expressive, timely, and natural reactions.
